app.title: Fortnite AI Coach
app.tagline: Post-session coaching. Nothing runs while you play.
gemini.configured_untested: API key saved - connection not tested yet
error.video: The video could not be processed.
error.ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg was not found. Install it or set its path in Settings.
error.usage_limit: Usage limit reached. No request was sent.
common.in_development_tip: This page is not functional yet. It will be completed in the phase shown.
gemini.status_tip: AI analysis is available only after a Gemini API key is saved and tested in Settings.
page.dashboard.subtitle: Your overall picture, built only from analyzed sessions.
page.gameplay.subtitle: Analyze a finished match recording after you stop playing.
page.training_sessions.subtitle: Analyze Creative training recordings (free build, 1v1, box fights, zone wars).
page.building.subtitle: Placement, sequences, height control and defensive building.
page.editing.subtitle: Edit accuracy, timing, crosshair placement and exposure after edits.
page.piece_control.subtitle: Taking and keeping control of walls, cones and floors.
page.aim.subtitle: What can be seen on screen: crosshair placement, tracking and shot timing.
page.game_sense.subtitle: Fight timing, positioning, risk and engagement decisions.
page.training_plan.subtitle: Exercises chosen from your real mistakes.
page.progress.subtitle: Ratings over time and repeated vs. resolved mistakes.
page.history.subtitle: Every analyzed session and its report.
page.settings.subtitle: Language, Gemini connection, usage limits and data.
page.training_plan.empty_text: A personal plan is created from the mistakes found in your analyzed sessions. Analyze a session first.
page.progress.empty_text: Charts appear after at least two analyzed sessions. Nothing is estimated without data.
page.history.empty_text: Every session you analyze will be listed here with its full report.
dash.skill_ratings_sub: AI estimates from video evidence. Skills without evidence stay empty.
dash.priorities_empty: Your three biggest weaknesses will appear here after your first analysis.
dash.weekly_empty: Weekly trends appear once you have analyzed sessions in more than one week.
dash.improvements_sub: Mistakes seen in 2+ sessions, and ones you have stopped making.
dash.mistakes_empty: Needs at least two analyzed sessions.
dash.recent_empty: Go to Gameplay Analysis or Training Sessions after you finish playing.
skillpage.rubric_sub: Only what is visible in your recording is judged.
skillpage.findings_empty: Timestamped findings for this skill will appear after an analysis.
rubric.aim.note: Not measured from video: real mouse accuracy, DPI, sensitivity or reaction time.
settings.gemini_sub: Used only when you start an analysis.
settings.data_sub: Stored only on this computer. Your video files are never copied or deleted.
settings.clear_cache_tip: Deletes extracted frames and compressed clips. Reports are kept.
settings.clear_cache_confirm: Delete all cached frames and clips? Your reports and videos are not affected.
settings.delete_all_tip: Deletes sessions, reports, scores, mistakes, training plans and usage history.
settings.delete_all_confirm: Permanently delete all sessions, reports, scores, training plans and usage history? Your video files stay on disk. This cannot be undone.
page.profile.subtitle: Who you are as a player, learned only from your analyzed sessions.
page.movement.subtitle: Strafing, jump timing, peeking, dodging and positioning in fights.
skillpage.tracked_mistakes_sub: Each has a fixed code, so repeats are counted across sessions.
profile.name: Display name
profile.needs_two_skills: Not enough data. Needs at least two skills with evidence from analyzed videos.
profile.patterns_sub: Repeated mistakes, improving and stuck areas, training that works.
profile.patterns_empty: Appears after several analyzed sessions. Nothing is guessed.
depth.detailed.desc: higher-quality clip per segment, more quota
analysis.setup_sub: Analysis runs only when you click Analyze, after you have finished playing.
analysis.coverage: Will analyze {analyzed} of {total} ({n} segments). Measured from the file.
analysis.not_covered: Not analyzed: {start}–{end} (over your video length limit in Settings).
analysis.need_video: Record or import a video first.
analysis.need_key: Gemini API key not configured. Add it in Settings → Gemini AI. Recording, import and preview work without it.
analysis.need_test: API key saved, but the connection has not been tested yet. Connection testing arrives in Phase 6, so analysis stays off until then.
analysis.coming_phase7: Gemini is connected. The analysis pipeline arrives in Phase 7. Nothing is simulated before that.
apikey.placeholder_saved: Saved key: {masked}. Paste a new key to replace it
apikey.delete_confirm: Delete the saved Gemini API key from Windows Credential Manager?
apikey.saved: Key saved securely. It will be checked by the connection test.
apikey.saved_unusual: Key saved, but it does not look like a usual Gemini key (normally 39 characters starting with AIza). The connection test will tell if it works.
apikey.err_format: This does not look like an API key (letters, digits, - and _ only, 20–200 characters).
apikey.err_no_backend: Secure storage (Windows Credential Manager) is not available, so the key was NOT saved. It is never stored as plain text.
apikey.err_save: The key could not be saved to secure storage.
apikey.where: Stored only in Windows Credential Manager. Never in files, the database or logs.
apikey.status_explain.not_configured: No key yet. Everything except AI analysis works.
apikey.status_explain.configured_unteste: A key is saved. It has not been verified yet; the connection test is added in Phase 6.
apikey.free_tier: Free Tier only: the app never enables billing or switches to a paid model.
apikey.guide: How to get a key: open Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com) → Get API key → Create API key → copy it → paste it above → Save. Free Tier requests may be used by Google to improve its products, so only analyze videos you are comfortable sharing.
rec.title: Record
rec.subtitle: Starts and stops only when you say so. Nothing is recorded automatically.
rec.detecting: Checking which encoders really work on this PC…
rec.not_detected: Hardware not checked yet. Open Gameplay Analysis or click Check hardware.
rec.not_available: Recording is not available here: ffmpeg needs Windows screen capture (ddagrab or gdigrab) and a working encoder.
rec.hw_note: GPU encoding: low CPU load, but recording always costs some FPS.
rec.cpu_warning: No GPU encoder works on this PC, so the CPU encodes (x264). Expect a noticeable FPS cost; try 720p / 30 FPS.
rec.video_only: Video only (no audio device selected in Settings).
rec.hotkeys_windows_only: Global hotkeys work on Windows only.
rec.fps_note: Tip: use Windowed Fullscreen in Fortnite; exclusive fullscreen may not be captured.
rec.err_unavailable: Recording cannot start: no working capture method or encoder was found.
rec.err_ffmpeg: Recording stopped with an ffmpeg error: {detail}
rec.err_hotkey: Invalid hotkeys. Use a modifier plus a key (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+F9), and different keys for start and stop.
rec.settings_sub: Used only when you start a recording.
video.import_sub: From the Fortnite recorder, OBS, NVIDIA ShadowPlay or any other program.
video.import_hint: MP4, MOV, MKV or WebM. You can also drag a file onto this page. The file is not copied.
video.err_replay: Fortnite .replay files are not supported. Export the replay as a video first.
video.err_format: Unsupported format. Use MP4, MOV, MKV or WebM.
video.err_no_video: The file has no video stream.
video.err_unreadable: The video could not be read. It may be damaged or still being written.
video.recent_empty: Record or import a video to see it here.
